scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.build: npm run build -w @subcycle/shared && npm run build -w @subcycle/api && npm run build -w @subcycle/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @subcycle/shared && npm run typecheck -w @subcycle/api && npm run typecheck -w @subcycle/web && npm run typecheck -w @subcycle/e2e
scripts.migrate: npm run build -w @subcycle/shared && npm run migrate -w @subcycle/api
scripts.admin:reset-link: npm run build -w @subcycle/shared && npm run admin:reset-link -w @subcycle/api --
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @subcycle/shared && npm run dev -w @subcycle/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @subcycle/shared && npm test -w @subcycle/api && npm test -w @subcycle/web
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @subcycle/shared && npm run dev -w @subcycle/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test -w @subcycle/e2e
